title: Input
description: Settings for how you type during practice.
note: This setting is saved in this browser.
unsaved: The setting can't be saved, so it applies only while this page is open.

simpleSpecial.heading: Simple special-character input
simpleSpecial.description: Lets you type letters with accents, tildes and other marks — like í, ó, ñ and č in Czech or Spanish — with the plain letter (i, o, n, c). Typing the marked letter itself is still correct.
simpleSpecial.label: Use simple special-character input
simpleSpecial.hint: When on, special characters such as á and č count as correct when you type a and c.

ignoreCase.heading: Ignore upper and lower case
ignoreCase.description: Treats upper and lower case, such as A and a, as the same letter. Typing with or without Shift is correct either way.
ignoreCase.label: Ignore upper and lower case
ignoreCase.hint: When on, capitals such as A and É count as correct when you type a and é (and the other way round).
